axes.name: type_declaration
axes.rationale: Target sign-extends object type via CWDE; a signed char is the direct source hypothesis.

axes.name: open_update_form
axes.rationale: The target changes only bit 2 after detecting a difference; test the XOR update and equivalent masked assignment.

axes.name: closed_update_form
axes.rationale: Closed windows still receive the same bit-2 assignment, without redraw.

axes.name: type_dispatch
axes.rationale: Preserve the target comparison sequence from the packet: equal 0x11, above 0x11, then values 5 and 13.
values: if (type == 0x11) { win_DrawObject(object); } else if (type > 0x11) { GRectInv(object); } else if (type == 5) { win_DrawObject(object); } else if (type == 0x0d) { GSetAttrib(_foreColor, _backColor, monoPat & 0x7f); win_DrawBitMapAtObj(object, object->bitmap[@BITMAP_INDEX@]); } else { GRectInv(object); }

switch (type) { case 0x11: case 5: win_DrawObject(object); break; case 0x0d: GSetAttrib(_foreColor, _backColor, monoPat & 0x7f); win_DrawBitMapAtObj(object, object->bitmap[@BITMAP_INDEX@]); break; default: GRectInv(object); break; }

axes.name: bitmap_index
axes.rationale: The target selects byte offsets 2 or 4 from an array base at object+0x26, corresponding to array indices 1 or 2.

spec.semantic_summary: Set bit 2 to the requested value even when the window is closed; redraw after a change by type, and redraw only bitmap objects when unchanged.
binding_evidence: Packet names direct globals clipDC, win_hwnd, monoPat, __backColor and __foreColor; type/state and far-call references are at the offsets in packet.md.

promotion: NONE: independent rebuild and recipe review required
